zh: 考虑两个显然的下界：每次最多发 2 件，所以至少 ⌈n/2⌉ 次；同一地点的商品不能一起发，出现最多的地点有 f 件，就至少要 f 次。
这两个下界中较大的那个总能达到：若某地点占多数，就让它的每件商品尽量和其它地点配对，剩下的单发；否则总能两两配成不同地点，最多剩一件单发。
统计每个地点的出现次数（排序后数连续段或用哈希表），取最大频次 f，输出 max(f, (n+1)/2)。
en: Consider two obvious lower bounds: each shipment carries at most 2 items, so at least ceil(n/2) shipments; items from the same location cannot ship together, so if the most frequent location has f items, at least f shipments.

The larger of the two bounds is always achievable: if one location is a majority, pair each of its items with an item from another location and ship the rest alone; otherwise items can be paired across different locations with at most one left over.
Count how often each location occurs (sort and count runs, or use a hash map), take the largest frequency f, and print max(f, (n+1)/2).

explanationEn:
## Approach

Let the most frequent location occur f times; the answer is max(f, ceil(n/2)).

## Proof of correctness

Each shipment carries at most 2 items, so at least ceil(n/2) shipments are needed; items from the same location cannot be paired, so the f items of the most frequent location need at least f shipments. If one location is a majority, pair it with the other locations first and then ship the remainder alone; otherwise the items can be paired so that at most one single item remains, reaching the larger lower bound.

## Complexity

O(n) time and O(n) space.
